decisions.acceptance: Every public-valid dtype/domain/layout is represented or remains an explicit unclosed gap; exact cast/alias/error and native-precision evidence per variant.
decisions.problem: A universal numeric dtype/promotion rule or scalar-only scope would erase documented structured/object/string/datetime/resource/quantized/weak-scalar distinctions.
decisions.recommendation: Use one generic Scalar/Representation/Promotion/Accumulator policy surface and associated storage/layout traits; encode reference semantic policies explicitly without cloned dtype kernels or silent f64 widening. Runtime object/protocol boundaries get typed schemas/erasure only where their actual domain requires it.
decisions.title: Native generic array/tensor numerical contract

decisions.acceptance: WF07 preserves Ref VJP accumulation100->104, resource mutation/order and source-invalid operation errors; vmap/shard/custom-gradient restrictions explicitly enumerated.
decisions.problem: Pure/stateless-only exclusion conflicts with frozen JAX Ref, TF Variable and Torch mutation semantics.
decisions.recommendation: Represent owned resources with branded lifetimes, typed effect tokens/region state and associated tangent/adjoint accumulator policies; lower through first-party trace/AD IR with legal alias/effect proofs. Keep pure state threading as a supported policy, not the only architecture.
decisions.title: Effect-aware Ref and resource AD

decisions.acceptance: WF06/WF15/WF19 cover eager/fullgraph/shape/control/effect/custom-op/format variants, versioned schema limits and real native execution without hidden foreign runtime.
decisions.problem: Banning compiler/graph/shape/export capabilities because foreign runtimes are forbidden would narrow full parity.
decisions.recommendation: Typed shape/effect/AD IR and generic lowering/backend traits in Coeus/Hephaestus; implement source-compatible capture/control/guard semantics and format import/export translators. Execute Atlas native IR; run XLA/TF/Torch/ORT only as isolated oracle/target interoperability tests.
decisions.title: First-party compiler with compatible artifact boundaries

decisions.acceptance: WF12/WF13/WF23 use real ranks/devices/network, precise scaling/ordering and exact fault evidence; native-Tokio executor lane and coordinator notification lane remain separate.
decisions.problem: NCCL/Gloo/PJRT/TF strategies expose different device, asynchronous completion and failure behaviors; a single-process or CPU fallback cannot close them.
decisions.recommendation: Moirai supplies typed rendezvous/rank/process/collective and cancellation state machines; Themis placement, Melinoe capability proofs and Hephaestus device communication implement concrete backends. Coeus owns gradient scaling, sharding and distributed training policies.
decisions.title: Native collective and topology semantics

decisions.acceptance: WF14/WF15 compare state/alias/version/signature semantics after fresh reload; independently execute each interchange target; corruption tests and no foreign runtime adoption.
decisions.problem: A single Rust checkpoint or universal serialization alias cannot cover NPY/NPZ/.keras/H5/state_dict/SavedModel/StableHLO/ONNX/LiteRT/OpenVINO/Torch export.
decisions.recommendation: Consus owns schema, integrity, ownership and storage primitives; Coeus composes model/optimizer/RNG/data/graph state and format translators. Separate safe/trusted object reconstruction policy from numeric tensor storage, with typed errors and explicit user trust options.
decisions.title: Versioned artifact and foreign interchange schemas

decisions.acceptance: Every companion inventory row receives scoped version/format/build/hardware decision or stays explicitly unresolved; root source evidence never grants companion semantic/implementation/runtime credit.
decisions.problem: Root framework versions do not version Flax/Optax/Orbax/TorchAO/ExecuTorch/LiteRT/Serving/TF.js/OpenVINO/ONNX/ORT or their public APIs. Dropping documented target workflows or declaring the whole ecosystem equivalent is unjustified.
decisions.recommendation: Keep frozen root releases; distinguish required root/runtime/build dependencies, documented optional workflow companions and adjacent ecosystem scope. Resolve a signed-off companion API/version/ABI/opset matrix and hashed artifacts before claiming any target; do not downgrade roots as a workaround.
decisions.title: Companion ecosystem boundary and independent version pins

decisions.acceptance: WF16/WF18/WF19 target selection covers public obligations and documents unresolved companions; no facade delegating Atlas computation to foreign frameworks.
decisions.problem: Python-only bindings omit documented native/extension/mobile/browser capabilities and cannot be justified by a workspace language preference.
decisions.recommendation: Provide a reviewed stable native C/schema boundary and language bindings with generic typed core, versioned ABI, explicit buffer ownership/stream handoff and first-party target lowering. Edge/browser/embedded runtimes remain capability-specific targets, with real target execution and build receipts.
decisions.title: Public native and edge surface functional equivalence

decisions.acceptance: WF04 separately verifies bitstream/splitting/state guarantees, law/parameter domains and justified statistical tests, including device/parallel configuration.
decisions.problem: Similar sample statistics cannot establish source-promised exact stream splitting/state replay or reference-valid statistical distributions.
decisions.recommendation: Typed algorithm/key/state/splitting policies with provider-native sampling and device implementations; versioned stream compatibility and statistical specifications are independent contracts.
decisions.title: RNG sequence promises distinct from distribution equivalence
